JD conversion through jd.union.open.promotion.common.get per D10-500 and BR-ATTR-06 (TRADE-11 default): materialId in the union itemId form, siteId from configuration, positionId from the server identity, subUnionId read as is from the linking identity and absent for no_rebate, sceneId 1. Error codes map per CAP-JD-06. Only the jdLive block of registry and union.module changed. The JD endpoint stays demo. Measured: common.get issues a link with subUnionId; order return of subUnionId is not yet verified and CAP-JD-05 records it as pending a real order.
